name: Dermos
description: Dermos was a planet in the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A group of insurgents planning a raid on Dermos were apprehended by the Imperial Security Bureau in 3 ABY. When New Republic pilot Wedge Antilles went missing in 4 ABY, Ensign Ardin Deltura suggested Antilles might be at Dermos.
